=== a program at the reset vector, with an interrupt vector
	.org 0
	ljmp main
	.org 0x0b
	cpl P1.0
	reti
	.org 0x30
main:	mov SP,#0x5f
	mov TMOD,#0x01
	mov TH0,#0xfc
	mov TL0,#0x18
	setb TR0
	setb ET0
	setb EA
loop:	sjmp loop
=== the register and bit names both references define
	mov A,P0
	mov A,SP
	mov A,DPL
	mov A,DPH
	mov A,PCON
	mov A,TCON
	mov A,TMOD
	mov A,TL0
	mov A,TL1
	mov A,TH0
	mov A,TH1
	mov A,P1
	mov A,SCON
	mov A,SBUF
	mov A,P2
	mov A,IE
	mov A,P3
	mov A,IP
	mov A,PSW
	mov A,ACC
	mov A,B
	setb IT0
	setb IE0
	setb IT1
	setb IE1
	setb TR0
	setb TF0
	setb TR1
	setb TF1
	setb RI
	setb TI
	setb RB8
	setb TB8
	setb REN
	setb SM2
	setb SM1
	setb SM0
	setb EX0
	setb ET0
	setb EX1
	setb ET1
	setb ES
	setb EA
	setb RXD
	setb TXD
	setb INT0
	setb INT1
	setb PX0
	setb PT0
	setb PX1
	setb PT1
	setb PS
	setb P
	setb OV
	setb RS0
	setb RS1
	setb F0
	setb AC
	jb CY,.
=== register bits by name
	mov C,ACC.7
	mov PSW.5,C
	jb TCON.5,.
	jnb B.0,.
	anl C,/P3.2
	orl C,SCON.0
	setb P0.0
	clr IP.5
	setb IE.7
	cpl P1.3
=== forward references
	.org 0x100
start:	mov A,#8
	mov R0,#0x30
	mov DPTR,#table
	lcall fill
	ljmp done
fill:	mov @R0,A
	inc R0
	djnz ACC,fill
	ret
table:	.db 1,2,3,4
done:	sjmp done
=== AJMP and ACALL to every page of their block
; By label: sdld refuses a numeric target outside block 0 as off the page.
	.org 0x800
p0:	ajmp p0
	ajmp p1
	ajmp p2
	ajmp p3
	acall p4
	acall p5
	acall p6
	acall p7
	.org 0x900
p1:	nop
	.org 0xa00
p2:	nop
	.org 0xb00
p3:	nop
	.org 0xc00
p4:	nop
	.org 0xd00
p5:	nop
	.org 0xe00
p6:	nop
	.org 0xfff
p7:	nop
=== AJMP and ACALL to labels either side of the instruction
	.org 0x1000
top:	nop
	.org 0x1400
	ajmp top
	acall bottom
	ajmp .
	.org 0x17f0
bottom:	ret
=== AJMP ending a block, two bytes before its boundary
	.org 0x7fa
	ajmp 0
	acall 0x7ff
	nop
	nop
=== relative branches at the edge of their reach, by label
	.org 0x100
	sjmp fwd
	.ds 127
fwd:	nop
bwd:	.ds 126
	sjmp bwd
	jz fwd2
	.ds 127
fwd2:	nop
=== three-byte branches at the edge of their reach
	.org 0x200
	cjne A,#1,fwd
	.ds 127
fwd:	djnz 0x30,bwd
bwd:	nop
	.ds 124
	jb 0x20,bwd
=== relative branches at the edge of their reach, from the location counter
	.org 0x100
	sjmp .+129
	sjmp .-126
	jnc .-126
	djnz R2,.-126
	jbc 0x91,.-125
	cjne R3,#0,.-125
	cjne @R0,#0,.+130
	cjne A,0x30,.-125
	djnz 0x30,.+130
=== bytes, strings and reserved space
	.org 0
	mov DPTR,#msg
	movc A,@A+DPTR
	ret
msg:	.db 0x48,0x65,0x6c,0x6c,0x6f,13,10,0
	.ds 4
	.db 65,-1,255
	nop
=== a lookup table through MOVC A,@A+PC
	.org 0
	inc A
	movc A,@A+PC
	ret
	.db 0x3f,0x06,0x5b,0x4f
=== an equate
count	.equ 8
buffer	.equ 0x30
	mov A,#count
	mov R0,#buffer
	mov buffer,#count
=== nested delay loops
	.org 0
delay:	mov R7,#10
d1:	mov R6,#200
d2:	mov R5,#250
d3:	djnz R5,d3
	djnz R6,d2
	djnz R7,d1
	ret
=== external memory through DPTR and R0/R1
	.org 0
	mov DPTR,#0x8000
	movx A,@DPTR
	inc DPTR
	movx @DPTR,A
	mov R0,#0x40
	movx A,@R0
	movx @R1,A
	xch A,@R1
	xchd A,@R0
=== the location counter
	.org 0x1234
	mov DPTR,#.
	mov DPTR,#.+3
	sjmp .+2
